scope: Read actual final apparatus, starter, oracle, independent reference, completed control, validator, public/private tests, metadata, Dockerfile, AUTHOR and frozen reports. Independently checked equations and provenance; no numerical, local-control or model evaluation was rerun.
physics_findings: The translational drift contains the spatial derivative of the entire wall potential, including orientational interaction. The n=0,±1,±2 Fourier coefficients have the correct factors and signs.

Angular drift tau=−Dr*V_theta/T leads to Fourier couplings n*Dr*h*A*(c_(n−2)−c_(n+2))/(2T). These match the implemented generator; its c0 normalization is integral rho dx=1 and real cn are cosine moments.

Zero positional flux gives P/loading=T*rho(0)+v*integral_0^infinity m dx. The stationary first angular moment gives Dr*integral m=v*q(0)−T*m_prime(0)−integral sin(theta)*tau*psi. The moment-stress source is exact at h=0 and retains finite-channel anisotropy and polarization gradients.
Since sin(theta)*sin(2theta)=(cos(theta)−cos(3theta))/2, the oracle adds +v*integral h*A*(c1−c3)/(2T) dx. This has the correct sign for the defined right-coating reaction.

The reference independently solves a positive position-angle Markov generator using Scharfetter–Gummel potential differences and active spatial bias. It measures sum(V_x*probability) over the right wall directly rather than using the oracle moment conversion. Unit-particle normalization times the stated loading is force per y-length.

Both wall coatings carry their full potential when translated, so displacement work fixes the normal force uniquely. Negative alignment can create orientational attraction but the quartic potential still confines particles; thermal diffusion makes the stationary process well defined.

public_and_grading_review.readout: The actual mechanical reaction on the right coating per y-length, positive toward +x, with solvent/support background subtracted. No moment-stress or torque-correction formula appears publicly.
public_and_grading_review.public_boundary: Only README, starter, public test and calibration are copied to /app. Author, hint, reference and solution remain private.
public_and_grading_review.data: All records have only known controls, noisy value and fixed sigma. No response-shaped uncertainty or private parameter initialization.
public_and_grading_review.grading: Tests require documented output shape, finite values, fit recovery and relative observable errors; no algorithm or representation is required.

calibration.uncertainty: constant sigma=.001, independent of loading and response

science_report_review.limitation: Corner, refinement and passive-limit numerical evidence was reviewed as reported, not rerun or promoted to a whole-domain mathematical proof. Numerical negative density minima are roundoff scale.

local_controls_review.shortcut: 4 passed and exactly 3 intended hidden prediction failures
local_controls_review.warnings: Only inability to write pytest cache on the read-only local filesystem; no scientific or model runtime error.

causal_trial_guidance: A failure qualifies as this intended physical closure only if the final model keeps torque-free moment stress despite orienting walls. If it derives the actual coating-force integral or correct angular transfer but fails in implementation, record that mathematical/implementation cause separately.
